Largely lost. Daily Star Bangla (Mar 2025) says parts were demolished for a madrasa and the upazila complex now occupies part of the grounds; only an old pond and a walled temple with its well remain clearly visible. The 2015 Daily Star describes a gate, enclosure wall and throne building. Department of Archaeology protection for the palace itself was not confirmed (the audit says the department lists the megalithic tombs and Jaintiaswari Bari).
